1704-4493-5195-5362.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-4493-5195-5362.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Krark.
When you cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication, Krark, any additional copies of Krark, and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color..
Resolve a Krark trigger, flipping a coin and returning the Irenicus's Vile Duplication card to your hand if you lose and copying it if you win.
If you copy Irenicus's Vile Duplication, Storm-Kiln Artist triggers again, causing you to repeat steps 3 to 4.
Repeat steps 5—6 for each Krark trigger.
If Irenicus's Vile Duplication is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the Irenicus's Vile Duplication card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with Quantum Misalignment, if you still need more Krark copies.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both Irenicus's Vile Duplication and Quantum Misalignment end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

141-2034-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-2034-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3277-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
3277-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
3277-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Izzet Chronarch and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

413-824-2728-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
413-824-2728-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
413-824-2728-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat from step 4.

654-2557-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

851-1308-3129-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
4050-6972-7932.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

454-1978-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.
454-1978-7908.description:
Cause The Notary Hobbits to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-6633.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-6633.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-3443-6965.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-6965.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-6965.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

1274-6719-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-6719-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2079-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3185-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3185-5686-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

4004-6558-7149.description:
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Naga Fleshcrafter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Naga Fleshcrafter dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Naga Fleshcrafter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Naga Fleshcrafter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Naga Fleshcrafter from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

891-997-1258.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

141-6556-7302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
141-6556-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Patron of the Arts

1409-1652-6753.description:
Activate Patron of the Arts by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Patron of the Arts enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Patron of the Arts.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3532-3581-4928-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3581-4928-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient and Kykar trigger.
Resolve the Forgotten Ancient trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

851-4682-5140-5184.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
851-4682-5140-5184.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev and Xorn.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
851-4682-5140-5184.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

1491-4474-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {1}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Tui and La by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

301-1099-1768.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and Juniper Order Ranger.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

586-5258-5618-6747-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
586-5258-5618-6747-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2-4659-5554-6753.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

5414-5720-5721-6664.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
5414-5720-5721-6664.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3951-5703-5929-6645.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr or Gogo.
3951-5703-5929-6645.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Gogo triggers, causing it to become a copy of Altaïr with its name not changing, and causing both Gogo and Altaïr to get +2/+0 and haste until end of turn.
Declare Gogo and Altaïr as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the Godo trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

2376-4929-5224.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Together Forever, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

238-997-5756.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

1287-1770-6318.easyPrerequisites: You have either {4}{U}{U} or eight {E} available.
1287-1770-6318.description:
Cast Aethertide Whale by paying eight {E} if able or {4}{U}{U} otherwise.
When Aethertide Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Activate Aethertide Whale by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-2557-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
1308-2557-5658-6245.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
1308-2557-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

997-1429-4875-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-1429-4875-5402.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1429-5330-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5330-5402-5929.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

4200-5256-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Icewind Stalwart.
4200-5256-6132.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-647-997.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-647-997.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1069-1232-1753-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-1753-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1652-5626-5930.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-5626-5930.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

3391-4871-5147-6019.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1090-5640-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1090-5640-5917.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Restoration Angel.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2308-5468.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-2308-5468.description:
Cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
Kambal's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Kambal's second ability triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

3263-3657-4659-5432.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3263-3657-4659-5432.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents who each control at least one artifact.
3263-3657-4659-5432.description:
Cast Journey On either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G} and commander tax, if applicable, creating at least three Map artifact tokens and exiling Journey On with the ability to cast it from exile.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing three Maps, adding six {C}.
Cast Kellan from exile by paying {2}.
Activate Kogla by paying {2}, returning Kellan from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Maps, and you may use the Maps to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

1479-2515-5033.notablePrerequisites: You have a Desert land card in hand or in your graveyard that enters the battlefield untapped.
1479-2515-5033.description:
Play a Desert from your hand or your graveyard.
The Desert enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Hazezon.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hazezon trigger, creating two 1/1 Sand Warrior creature tokens.
The Sand Warriors enter the battlefield, triggering Kodama twice.
Resolve the first Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate the Desert by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the Desert from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Kodama trigger from step 5, putting the Desert from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Desert enters the battlefield, triggering Hazezon, creating two 1/1 Sand Warrior creature tokens.
Repeat from step 5.
